jobs.title: Surveillance Investigator
jobs.description:
*Company Overview*

Risk Control Canada Inc. is a leading Canadian security and risk management firm dedicated to providing expert solutions for companies, organizations, and private individuals. With a strong focus on risk management, protective services, and investigations, we pride ourselves on our reputation for delivering discreet and effective services.

*Summary*

We are seeking Surveillance Investigators to join our dynamic team at Risk Control Canada. In this role, you will be responsible for conducting surveillance operations to gather intelligence and support our clients' risk management needs.

These are contractor positions, contract assignments can vary in length and work hours can be anything from a few hours to very long hours depending on the individual assignment.

*Key Responsibilities*

*Surveillance*
- Use tools and technologies such as GPS tracking, covert cameras, and digital recording devices to conduct covert video and photographic surveillance in various environments using stationary and mobile techniques.

*Report Generation*
- Prepare detailed and objective reports documenting observations, interviews, findings, and recommendations.
- Maintain confidentiality and secure handling of sensitive information and evidence.

*Information gathering*
- Interview complainants, witnesses, and other involved parties to gather relevant statements and context for investigations.
- Analyze collected information to assess credibility, identify inconsistencies
- Conduct background investigations and open-source intelligence (OSINT) searches when required
- Collaborate with internal teams or external clients to clarify investigative objectives and provide timely updates.

*Requirements*
- High school diploma required; diploma or degree in criminology, law enforcement, or a related field preferred.
- Valid Private Investigator license
- Applicants must be able to pass a background investigation and obtain a vulnerable sector security clearance.
- Experience in surveillance, investigations, law enforcement, or corporate security is a strong asset.
- Strong interviewing skills with the ability to remain neutral, professional, and respectful.
- Excellent written communication and report-writing abilities.
- Strong observational and critical thinking skills.
- Proficiency in surveillance equipment and basic computer applications.
- Valid driver's license and access to a reliable, discreet vehicle.
- Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Pay: $30.00-$45.00 per hour

Benefits:
- Mileage reimbursement

Experience:
- Surveillance: 2 years (preferred)
- investigation: 2 years (preferred)

Licence/Certification:
- Private Investigator License (required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Contract Surveillance Investigator
jobs.description:
*Contract Licensed Surveillance Investigator*
*Location: Calgary, Alberta (with occasional travel throughout Alberta as required)*

MDSI is a well-established Alberta private investigations firm with over 25 years in operation. MDSI has earned a strong reputation for professionalism, integrity, and quality investigative work within the insurance and civil litigation sectors.

We are seeking a licensed, contract Surveillance Investigator to join our team in Calgary.

*Key Responsibilities*
- Conduct strategic mobile and stationary surveillance in urban and rural environments
- Accurately observe, document, and report investigative findings
- Produce clear, detailed, and timely written reports
- Conduct background investigations on individuals and corporations
- Adapt to varying schedules, including early mornings, occasional late evenings, and extended shifts
- Travel to various locations throughout Alberta, occasionally/as required
- Adhere strictly to MDSI's investigative methods, standards, best practices, and code of ethics

*Mandatory Requirements*
- Valid Alberta Private Investigator license
- Own discreet, nondescript vehicle suitable for surveillance operations
- Vehicle equipped with limo-tinted rear windows, or willingness to obtain prior to commencing surveillance
- Own camcorder (not a cell phone) with superior optical zoom & stabilization, a covert camera, and a computer, or willingness to acquire this equipment over time (can borrow equipment to start).
- Confident, skilled driver with strong situational awareness
- Physically fit and capable of extended periods of surveillance, both in a vehicle and on foot
- Willing and able to work alone for prolonged periods
- Flexible availability with the ability to start early mornings on a regular basis

*Preferred Attributes*
- Trainable mindset with openness to adapting to company-specific methodologies
- Self-starter with a results-driven, accountable mindset
- Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail
- Ability to blend seamlessly into a variety of environments and situations
- Professional, discreet, and reliable

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: $25.00-$40.00 per hour

Benefits:
- Casual dress
- Mileage reimbursement

Licence/Certification:
- Alberta Investigator License (required)

Work Location: In person
